debugSpins.description: Wild Multiplier ([0, x4, x3, x2, 0] in free spin, [0, x3, x2, x1, 0] in base game)
Reel expand [1,2,1,2,1] -> Free Spin(scatter in 1,3,5 reel) -> Extra Orca [1,1,1,1,1] -> Wild Multiplier [0, x3, 0, x1, 0]
Reel expand [1,2,1,2,1] -> Extra Orca [0,1,0,0,0] -> Wild Multiplier [0, x3, x2, x1, 0]
Wild appears on reel 2, 3, 4 & multiplier values are random
